# Pacing a half marathon

A half marathon is short enough to race hard and long enough to punish a fast start.

## Even splits

Pick a goal pace and hold it from the first kilometer. The fastest halves are run at nearly the same speed throughout.

## Fuel

Drink a little at every station and take a gel around the tenth kilometer.
